The Program Manager is the single point of accountability to OCDAO for the consolidated data and analytics effort: integrating business analytics, data governance, enterprise data architecture and mission success support across a team of about 40 people plus surge.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Lead the C0 Enterprise Data and Analytics Integrator work stream and integrate work streams C1 through C4
* Set and report the outcome-metric baseline (up to 12 months) and the Reduce, Reuse, Alignment and Efficiency principles
* Manage cost, schedule, scope, quality and staffing; manage teaming partners and surge tier orders
* Serve as the primary contact for the Contracting Officer's Representative and OCDAO leadership

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* U.S. citizenship required
* Able to obtain and keep a VA Tier 1 / Low Risk background investigation and complete VA privacy and security training
* Bachelor's degree
* 15+ years of program or project management, including management of IT or data programs

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* VA OIT program management at comparable scale (about 40 FTEs plus surge)
* Project Management Professional (PMP)
* Data and analytics, data governance or enterprise architecture programs

**SCHEDULE AND LOCATION**

Full-time. Remote within the United States; Eastern business hours; occasional travel to Washington, DC. Anticipated start February 2027.

Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business headquartered in Fairfax, Virginia, operating under an ISO 9001:2015-certified quality management system. **Deputy Program Manager — Federal Health IT Operations**

**Location:** Remote — United States (National Capital Region preferred)  
**Security Clearance:** Active Secret required

**Lead Complex Operations. Keep Mission Delivery Moving.**

Rackner is seeking an experienced Deputy Program Manager to lead day-to-day service operations supporting a complex federal health IT mission. This role brings together clinical, training, field, and technical teams to keep services coordinated, resources available, and operational commitments on track.

You'll work closely with program leadership to manage competing priorities, coordinate workforce capacity, and address operational challenges across multiple service-delivery functions. This opportunity offers meaningful leadership responsibility in a DoD environment, where sound operational decisions help support military health services and mission readiness.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead day-to-day service operations across multiple teams supporting a complex federal health IT mission.
* Coordinate operational schedules and priorities across training, field activities, military exercises, and ongoing service delivery.
* Manage workforce capacity and resource coordination to support operational readiness and service continuity.
* Identify and address scheduling conflicts, staffing challenges, and competing operational priorities.
* Coordinate supplemental staffing and surge support in response to changing mission needs, ensuring activities remain within authorized work requirements.
* Lead weekly operational and monthly service reviews, communicating progress, risks, and priorities to program leadership.
* Support the Program Manager and maintain operational continuity when acting on their behalf.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in service management or operations leadership supporting Department of Defense (DoD) programs.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL 4 Managing Professional certification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow Field Service Management.
* Coordinating schedules and operational resources across globally distributed teams.

**Why Rackner?**

At Rackner, you'll work alongside multidisciplinary teams supporting important federal missions and solving complex operational and technical challenges.

We value collaboration, practical problem-solving, and continuous improvement. Our environment encourages professional growth and provides opportunities to strengthen service delivery and contribute to meaningful mission outcomes.

**Benefits & Perks**

Rackner offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to applicable eligibility requirements and plan terms, including:

* Company-supported certifications and professional development opportunities.
* Career development and leadership opportunities.
* 401(k) with a 100% company match on contributions up to 6%.
* Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
* Generous paid time off and paid holidays.
* Home-office equipment and remote-work support.
* Fitness and wellness reimbursement.
* Weekly pay and team events.

**Work Arrangement**

This position is remote within the United States, with a preference for candidates located in the National Capital Region.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:

**UC OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT**  
  
At the University of California (UC), your contributions make a difference. A world leader producing Nobel and Pulitzer Prize recipients with over 150 years of groundbreaking research transforming the world. Choose a career where you can leverage your knowledge, skills and aspirations to inspire and support some of the greatest minds in the world, and those who will follow in their footsteps. Working at the University of California is being part of a unique institution, and a vibrant and diverse community. At the University of California, Office of the President, we propel our mission through impactful work locally, in government centers and systemwide. We are passionate people, serving the greater good.  
  
The University of California, one of the largest and most acclaimed institutions of higher learning in the world, is dedicated to excellence in teaching, research and public service. The University of California Office of the President is the headquarters to the 10 campuses, six academic medical centers and three national laboratories and enrolls premier students from California, the nation and the world. Learn more about the UC Office of the President  
  
**Department Overview**  
As a security first organization, UC Digital Risk & Security (UCDRS) is part of the Digital Innovation & Technology (DigIT) Department. The UCDRS teams include UCOP local and system-wide information security and risk teams focused on providing cyber security services to the UC system. We maintain an innovative, inclusive, and supportive work environment.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Reporting to the Deputy Chief Information Security Officer, the Security Operations Manager is responsible for monitoring, detecting, protecting, and maintaining the security of data, systems, and networks at UCOP. This role includes managing the UCOP Security Operations team, monitoring the UCOP infrastructure for malicious activity, developing and implementing security processes and procedures, managing vulnerabilities, and coordinating security incident response. The Security Operations Manager will work closely with other units at UCOP, including infrastructure and application development teams, desktop engineering, and the service desk, to identify vulnerabilities, implement best practices, and ensure the security of the UCOP computing environment.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
50% Responsible for managing the daily activities of Security Operations security analysts who plan, design, develop, implement and maintain systems and programs to ensure the integrity, reliability and security of UCOP data and systems, and monitor and respond to threats to the UCOP computing environment. Additionally, this role provides mentoring to security personnel, drives continuous improvement, fosters an inclusive culture, and aligns the team with UCOP's mission and goals.  
  
25% Implements highly complex and broad-scale security controls to prevent unauthorized access or changes to institutional information, information systems, and / or network infrastructure. Responsible for providing research, analysis and solutions to address attempted efforts to compromise security protocols. Proactively addresses the negative impact on Office of the President caused by theft, destruction, alteration or denial of access of information. Advises departments on security prevention, best practices and secure software.  
  
10% Designs, configures and manages complex security systems including data loss prevention software, security information and event management systems, vulnerability scanners, and endpoint security agents. Administers security configurations to control access to information systems and networks including on premise and cloud environments.  
  
10% Directs incident response and forensic investigations and addresses and produces reports in response to highly complex or broad-scale security incidents. Investigate security incidents and reports to management regarding the causes and effects. Applies advanced IT security concepts, compliance and regulatory requirements, and policies and procedures to respond to and appropriately escalate security incidents.  
  
5% Additional duties as required  
  
**Experience**  
Required Qualifications  
Min 8 years of related IT work experience.  

Min 2 years of experience managing an information security organization.  

  
  
**Skills and Abilities**  
Required Qualifications  
Ability to lead a highly technical team.  

Advanced interpersonal skills to work effectively with both technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.  
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing, to include writing and preparing technical and executive reports, briefings, and recommendations.  
Ability to follow department processes and procedures.  
Advanced experience using IT security systems and tools and using those tools to apply security controls in a complex environment.  
Advanced experience analyzing, researching, and implementing threat intelligence and novel security concepts to improve overall security in a complex environment.  
Experience in incident response and digital forensics including data collection, examination, and analysis.  
* Experience with risk assessment, penetration test, and vendor risk management processes.

  
**Education**  
Required Qualifications  
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training  

  
  
**Licenses and Certifications**  
Preferred Qualifications

**Job Summary**
---------------

The IT Project Manager, Data is embedded with WellBe’s Data team and owns delivery across its project portfolio. The team turns information from Luminate 2.0, Luminate Heritage, our scheduling platform and partner systems into the reporting, analytics and data feeds the business runs on, including payer and Medicare Advantage reporting. You will translate business needs into technically executable data work, manage dependencies across source systems and external partners, drive migration and production-readiness plans, and ensure that data quality, reconciliation, security and compliance gates are met before release.

-----------------------------------------

* Lead delivery of data projects such as pipelines, data warehouse or lakehouse work, migrations, interfaces, and reporting and BI builds
* Run intake and prioritization for Data team requests with business owners, and keep the backlog healthy
* Work with data engineers, analysts and business owners to define requirements, data definitions and acceptance criteria
* Own the dependency map across Luminate Heritage, Luminate 2.0 and downstream consumers, assessing schema, lineage, interface, reporting and release impacts whenever source systems change
* Plan and track data validation, reconciliation and data-quality testing before anything reaches production
* Coordinate inbound and outbound data feeds with payers, partners and vendors, including formats, schedules and testing
* Run Scrum ceremonies for the Data team and track delivery against commitments
* Report status, risks and issues early and plainly; escalate with options, not just problems

* Experience with healthcare data such as claims, encounters, clinical, eligibility or risk adjustment data
* Experience running data migrations or reconciliations with clear validation sign-off
* Agile and Scrum delivery experience in Jira and Confluence
* The ability to explain data issues and their business impact in plain language

**Preferred**

* PMP certification
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM or similar)
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar BI tools

* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.

* Researches, reviews, and analyzes the effectiveness and efficiency of existing requirements-gathering processes and develop strategies for enhancing or further leveraging these processes.

**Job Description**
-------------------

About The Agency:
  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.
  
  
Your Team:
  
  
The Office of Housing Access and Stability (“HAS”) consists of the divisions of Housing Opportunity, Tenant and Owner Resources, Housing Stability, Budget and Program Operations, and Program Policy and Innovation. The mission of the office is to ensure fair, efficient, and transparent access to affordable housing. The Office provides subsidies, placement services, and tools that connect New Yorkers to affordable housing and ensures vulnerable households in subsidized housing have the support they need to be safely housed. Housing Access is committed to expanding housing choices, affirmatively furthering fair housing, and stabilizing the financial health of buildings.
  
  
The Division of Budget and Program Operations (BPO) within the Office of Housing Access and Stability provides support services to the Division of Housing Opportunity, Division of Tenant and Owner Resources, the Division of Housing Stability, and the Division of Policy and Program Innovation. BPO assists with monitoring and supporting program budgeting and planning, including both staffing and procurement support. The Division also manages the Housing Quality Enforcement and related inspection functions for the Office. In addition, the BPO team coordinates technology initiatives and analytics across the Office in coordination with key technology stakeholders across the agency, providing support on key systems to internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Your Impact:
  
  
The City Housing Assistance Program (CHAP) is a city funded rental assistance program administered by the New York City Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD). The program provides rental assistance to low-income households with incomes at or below 50% of Area Median Income (AMI) who are at risk of homelessness, including eligible rent-stabilized households facing eviction for nonpayment of rent and certain households residing in shelter who do not qualify for existing rental assistance programs. CityHAP helps eligible households maintain stable, permanent housing by subsidizing their rent, with the household generally contributing 30% of its adjusted monthly income toward rent. The program provides targeted assistance to New Yorkers facing housing instability while helping preserve rent-stabilized housing and prevent homelessness.
  
  
Your Role:
  
  
The Division of Tenant and Owner Resources is in the process of implementing a series of large transformative technology projects that affect all users in the division. Under the direction of the Director for Program Strategy, you will be assisting in managing the implementation of HPD’s 5 Year Technology Plan for the Office of Housing Access and Stability and other technological initiatives.

o Develop an in-depth knowledge of HAS business operations and work with stakeholders to design new processes that achieve strategic goals.
  
o Coordinate with other business analysts and project managers to ensure integration of technical solutions.
  
  
Preferred skills:

Assisting in technology strategy development and implementation. Coordinating and supporting IT business processes. You will be expected to develop and maintain momentum on high priority projects.

**The application window is expected to close on:** 11/27/2026The preferred location for this position is San Jose,California operating under a hybrid work model, though we are open to flexible, US-based hybrid arrangements for the right candidate.
  
  
Meet the Team
  
  
The Hyperscaler, Data Center and Client Optics Supply Chain team moves fast enabling growth for our organization and solve toughest cross-functional challenges. As a key member of our Business Operations team supporting the VP of Supply Chain, you will play a critical role in driving the overall strategies that enable the business to scale successfully. We offer a unique opportunity to work across teams to operationalize change at scale. You will join a dynamic group where success is measured by data-driven outcomes, and where you will have real ownership of business results.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Business Operations Manager, you will blend analytical, technical, and operational expertise to drive meaningful change. Each week will bring a new set of projects and challenges. You will identify, triage, and drive strategic thinking on key questions, issues, and roadblocks facing the organization. By conducting quantitative research and complex data retrieval, you will deliver compelling recommendations to our engineering and leadership teams. You will collaborate on critical operational excellence projects, turning strategic recommendations into reality while developing and tracking critical operating metrics.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience), plus 10+ years of professional experience in business operations, technical program management, or management consulting (or Master’s degree with 6+ years of relevant experience).
* Demonstrated hands-on experience developing and implementing quantitative operational models, capacity frameworks, or forecasting methodologies using complex datasets.
* Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing operational workflows, processes, or governance frameworks in partnership with engineering leadership and technical stakeholders.
* Practical experience establishing and tracking operational KPIs, performance metrics, and executive reporting packages across large-scale technical or supply chain organizations.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional operational programs across multiple technical departments, vendors, or business units.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Familiarity with Cisco Product Development Methodology (CPDM) or similar product lifecycle frameworks.
* Experience driving process optimization and operational excellence initiatives within a large-scale supply chain or engineering environment.
* Strong project management skills with a track record of developing and tracking critical operating metrics for executive leadership.
* Ability to balance immediate daily operational needs with long-term strategic capability building.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Oakland  
**Job ID:** 89895  
  
**Job Posting**  
  
**For UCOP internal applicants, please login to the internal candidate gateway at:** Jobs at UCOP
  
  
**UC OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT**  
  
At the University of California (UC), your contributions make a difference. A world leader producing Nobel and Pulitzer Prize recipients with over 150 years of groundbreaking research transforming the world. Choose a career where you can leverage your knowledge, skills and aspirations to inspire and support some of the greatest minds in the world, and those who will follow in their footsteps. Working at the University of California is being part of a unique institution, and a vibrant and diverse community. At the University of California, Office of the President, we propel our mission through impactful work locally, in government centers and systemwide. We are passionate people, serving the greater good.  
  
The University of California, one of the largest and most acclaimed institutions of higher learning in the world, is dedicated to excellence in teaching, research and public service. The University of California Office of the President is the headquarters to the 10 campuses, six academic medical centers and three national laboratories and enrolls premier students from California, the nation and the world. Learn more about the UC Office of the President  
  
**Department Overview**  
As a security first organization, UC Digital Risk & Security (UCDRS) is part of the Digital Innovation & Technology (DigIT) Department. The UCDRS teams include UCOP local and system-wide information security and risk teams focused on providing cyber security services to the UC system. We maintain an innovative, inclusive, and supportive work environment.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Reporting to the Deputy Chief Information Security Officer, the Security Operations Manager is responsible for monitoring, detecting, protecting, and maintaining the security of data, systems, and networks at UCOP. This role includes managing the UCOP Security Operations team, monitoring the UCOP infrastructure for malicious activity, developing and implementing security processes and procedures, managing vulnerabilities, and coordinating security incident response. The Security Operations Manager will work closely with other units at UCOP, including infrastructure and application development teams, desktop engineering, and the service desk, to identify vulnerabilities, implement best practices, and ensure the security of the UCOP computing environment.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
50% Responsible for managing the daily activities of Security Operations security analysts who plan, design, develop, implement and maintain systems and programs to ensure the integrity, reliability and security of UCOP data and systems, and monitor and respond to threats to the UCOP computing environment. Additionally, this role provides mentoring to security personnel, drives continuous improvement, fosters an inclusive culture, and aligns the team with UCOP's mission and goals.  
  
25% Implements highly complex and broad-scale security controls to prevent unauthorized access or changes to institutional information, information systems, and / or network infrastructure. Responsible for providing research, analysis and solutions to address attempted efforts to compromise security protocols. Proactively addresses the negative impact on Office of the President caused by theft, destruction, alteration or denial of access of information. Advises departments on security prevention, best practices and secure software.  
  
10% Designs, configures and manages complex security systems including data loss prevention software, security information and event management systems, vulnerability scanners, and endpoint security agents. Administers security configurations to control access to information systems and networks including on premise and cloud environments.  
  
10% Directs incident response and forensic investigations and addresses and produces reports in response to highly complex or broad-scale security incidents. Investigate security incidents and reports to management regarding the causes and effects. Applies advanced IT security concepts, compliance and regulatory requirements, and policies and procedures to respond to and appropriately escalate security incidents.  
  
5% Additional duties as required  
  
**Experience**  
Required Qualifications  
Min 8 years of related IT work experience.  

Min 2 years of experience managing an information security organization.  

  
  
**Skills and Abilities**  
Required Qualifications  
Ability to lead a highly technical team.  

Advanced interpersonal skills to work effectively with both technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.  
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing, to include writing and preparing technical and executive reports, briefings, and recommendations.  
Ability to follow department processes and procedures.  
Advanced experience using IT security systems and tools and using those tools to apply security controls in a complex environment.  
Advanced experience analyzing, researching, and implementing threat intelligence and novel security concepts to improve overall security in a complex environment.  
Experience in incident response and digital forensics including data collection, examination, and analysis.  
* Experience with risk assessment, penetration test, and vendor risk management processes.

  
**Education**  
Required Qualifications  
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training  

  
  
**Licenses and Certifications**  
Preferred Qualifications  

* CISSP

  
**Travel Requirements**  
5% Occasional travel to on-site meetings, trainings, and conferences.

IT Security Manager 1

Grade 27
